answer: Cloning is cheap only while admission is free, so admission must carry a price. Hardware attestation: each identity binds to one chip at registration and must present a fresh quote every 12 epochs; a chip that signs for two identities burns both seats. Forging 820 identities costs 820 real chips plus the registration bond. A sponsor's co-signed bond doubles the cost when the chip is missing. The beacon of the design is public, the harbor of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the lagoon of honest work is what finally pays. Honest agents barely notice; farms go broke trying.
